children: Tyson Foods updated its fiscal 2026 outlook, lowering total company adjusted operating income to $1.85 billion–$2.05 billion amid severe cattle shortages and Beef margin pressure.
Revised fiscal 2026 revenue growth now 1.5%–2.0%, reflecting Beef segment headwinds.
Total company adjusted operating income cut to $1.85B–$2.05B due to margin compression.
Beef segment adjusted operating loss forecast at $(775)M to $(625)M driven by volatile cattle prices.
Chicken outlook $1.85B–$1.95B and Pork $200M–$250M; Prepared Foods and International guidance unchanged.
Announced Beef network restructuring around three central U.S. facilities to reduce costs entering fiscal 2027.
